thread:
laura: Heads-up — we need to decide the inspect-gate decision paths for console unmasking. Current ask from support: a short-lived escalation path for customers to enable 'inspect' on specific requests for debugging. How do we want to gate this?

sam: Do we mean the temporary unmask that shows PII in traces? or full request/response payloads?

laura: Just the temporary unmask on traces + the small payload viewer in Console. Not full exports. Support wants 1h TTL by default, manually granted.

pj: Concern: broad granting = audit + compliance risk. Need RBAC + explicit justification in the UI. Also must record who opened it and why.

ashley: +1 on audit. Also: should the gating be per-route or per-tenant? For multi-tenant customers, some routes are higher risk.

marco: I'd prefer role-based + per-route allowlist. Example flow: engineer requests inspect -> approver (sre/security) clicks approve -> console issues ephemeral token scoped to that route for TTL.

laura: That matches what product suggested. But product also wants a 'self-approve' mode for small teams (opt-in) — basically owner trusts their org. We need to support both but not mix.

sam: Could be a per-account policy flag: "inspect_self_approve": true|false. If false, route goes through approver queue. If true, automatic but still logged.

pj: Implementation nit: we need to ensure telemetry sampling doesn't leak more than necessary when inspect is enabled. If inspect overrides sampling and starts pulling full requests into traces, cost + PII surface explodes.

laura: Good point — we should constrain inspect to a separate high-fidelity trace stream that only persists while TTL active, and still apply scrub rules unless user explicitly requests a full unmask with a stronger approval.

ashley: UX: Console dialog should require a short justification and select scope: single-request | route | time-window. Also show last 7 approvals for that route.

marco: Security wants an explicit two-button approval: Approve (short) vs Approve & Retain (longer TTL with compliance ticket). Approve & Retain should kick off a retention workflow (SOP + ticket id).

security-bot: Automated note: retention >24h requires legal sign-off. See policy: https://internal.redwood/legal/inspect-retention || auto-tagging required.

sam: For telemetry: when inspect is active, we should tag all samples with inspect_id and keep a separate index. Sampling rate should not change automatically. But we should allow a one-time debug burst that temporarily raises sampling only for that route and inspect_id (with audit).

pj: Agree keep default sampling unchanged. For burst mode add quota check so customers can't explode costs. We can add a quota bucket called "inspect-debug-burst" that is billable and visible.

laura: OK, technical constraints: implement ephemeral tokens; audit events: inspect.requested, inspect.approved, inspect.revoked, inspect.playback. All include actor, justification, scope, route, TTL, inspect_id.

ashley: Need UI wire for the approval queue in Console -> Operations. I'll mock before EOD.

marco: One more edge: what about SSO/SCIM sync users who have org-level roles? Approvals must validate current role at approval time. If someone lost privilege after approving, their active inspect sessions should remain but be flagged for review.

pj: Agreed, flagging is enough. We should not silently drop sessions, but add a revocation suggestion.

sam: Implementation sketch (proto):
```json
{
  "inspect_policy": {
    "mode": "rbac", // rbac | self_approve
    "default_ttl_seconds": 3600,
    "burst_quota_id": "inspect-debug-burst",
    "retain_approval_requires_ticket": true
  }
}
```

laura: Nice. Also add field: "scrub_mode": "masked|partial_unmask|full_unmask" with default masked. Full_unmask requires legal approval.

security-bot: Reminder: full_unmask also requires customer consent logged (for some regions). See compliance mapping.

marco: Are we comfortable with the audit retention time? We'll need at least 1 year for security investigations. That's separate from payload retention.

pj: Audit events 7 years probably OK for high-sensitivity customers, but default 1 year. Make retention configurable per-tenant with limits.

laura: Action items: 1) eng-platform: rough API surfaces + token model (marco + sam) 2) product: UX mock for approval queue + dialog (ashley) 3) security: list triggers that escalate to legal (pj + security-bot) 4) infra: quota bucket + telemetry tag plan (sam)

ashley: I'll post mock link once done.

marco: I'll prototype token flow and ephemeral index. 

laura: Thanks all. We'll sync in the weekly platform sync; keeping this thread for follow-ups. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: Deployed staging feature flag: feat/inspect-gate-staging -> true (2026-03-20T15:12Z).

laura: Noted. Please add a canary with two internal tenants before widening.

sam: Will do canary and share telemetry dashboard link.

laura: End.
